interface.shortDescription: GeoNames gazetteer: place-name search, administrative hierarchy, nearby places and reverse geocoding, postal codes, and country info over 11M+ place names.
interface.longDescription: Global geographical gazetteer built on the GeoNames web services. Search 11M+ place names by name, feature class, and country; climb the administrative parent chain from a neighborhood to its continent or list a unit's children; reverse-geocode a coordinate to its enclosing country and subdivision plus nearby populated places; resolve postal codes to coordinates across 80+ countries; and read country metadata such as ISO codes, capital, currency, and languages. Requires a free GeoNames username. Data is CC BY, attributed to GeoNames.
